guides.favoredWhen: Jax wins by dodging the stun and tracking passive stacks; Irelia wins if she baits Counter Strike and fights fully stacked.

keyTips.text: Dodge her stun above all else. Never leap or trade into the setup; the landed stun starts everything she does.
keyTips.heading: Stun respect

keyTips.text: Track her passive stacks and Q resets. A fully stacked passive deals heavy damage, so count dashes and leave before the peak.
keyTips.heading: Stack tracking

keyTips.text: Hold Counter Strike until she commits. She sets up minions to bait E, so stun only the committed dash, never the feint.
keyTips.heading: E patience

tips.text: Take short trades and reset. The matchup favors you, but extended fights let her stack for free, so hit inside E and step out.
tips.heading: Short trades

tips.text: Punish her dash-ins with E when no exit minion remains. If she dashes without a way back, the stun locks her in the exchange she cannot leave.
tips.heading: Trap the dash

tips.text: Count Q resets across the fight. Each dash refreshes on a new target, so track the minion wave as her second resource bar.
tips.heading: Reset counting

tips.text: Vary the stun because she baits it. She wants E spent before committing, so hold longer on some trades and release early on others.
tips.heading: Unreadable E

tips.text: Disengage at full stacks. When the passive peaks, give ground and re-engage as it falls instead of fighting the stacked duelist.
tips.heading: Peak respect

tips.text: Finish when her Q targets and stun are down. Without resets and setup, her commit has no damage and no exit.
tips.heading: Finish window

guides.favoredWhen: Jax wins by surviving to Lethal Tempo scaling and punishing wasted W; Pantheon wins early poke and roam punishment.

keyTips.text: Survive the early lane on Lethal Tempo. His Q poke rules the opening levels, so farm through it and scale past him instead of forcing back.
keyTips.heading: Survive first

keyTips.text: Punish a wasted W when healthy. If he stuns nothing and you hold health, the spent shield-bypass is your kill window.
keyTips.heading: Punish window

keyTips.text: Hold Counter Strike against stun-and-retreat. His pattern pokes, stuns, and leaves before E catches him, so never throw E at the retreat.
keyTips.heading: E patience

tips.text: Farm under Q pressure without answering. Each answered poke extends his winning pattern, so take the CS and concede the trade.
tips.heading: Farm focus

tips.text: Jump without stunning into his held E. He keeps E ready to block the jump-stun, so vary the engage and never stun on pattern.
tips.heading: Engage variety

tips.text: Fight at level 6 instead of matching roams. Your combat ultimate beats his map-movement R, so take the duel while he looks elsewhere.
tips.heading: Level-6 turn

tips.text: Take Exhaust for committed all-ins. The summoner answers his burst window and turns his engage into your kill.
tips.heading: Summoner call

tips.text: All-in when his W and E are both down. Without the stun and the block, his kit has no answer to your sustained damage.
tips.heading: Combo window

tips.text: Push when he roams with R. Every departure costs him a wave, so shove hard and convert the lost farm into plates.
tips.heading: Roam punish

guides.favoredWhen: Jax wins by baiting the pull and stacking extended trades; Mordekaiser wins if he lands Q on commits and pushes off every jump.

keyTips.text: Dodge his E and Q, never walk into both. The pull sets up everything he does, so sidestep the E first and the Q never gets its angle.
keyTips.heading: Dodge rule

keyTips.text: Track his shield and commit only when it is down. Trading into a held shield wastes your burst and hands him the extended fight.
keyTips.heading: Shield respect

keyTips.text: Activate your ultimate after his to limit what the realm steals. His R first means fewer stolen resistances and a duel you can actually finish.
keyTips.heading: Ult order

tips.text: Bait his E before jumping in. He pushes off every bare leap, so show pressure until the pull is spent, then leap onto the cooldown gap.
tips.heading: E bait

tips.text: Punish a missed Q at once. His all-in depends on the Q landing, so the whiff is your commit signal for the extended trade.
tips.heading: Punish Q miss

tips.text: Re-engage after his E peel instead of accepting the reset. Each disengage costs you the stack-up, so stick back on once the pull is down.
tips.heading: Re-engage rule

tips.text: Keep the wave off his tower so his short-trade pattern never sets. His safe shorts need his turret nearby; mid-lane extended trades are yours.
tips.heading: Wave position

tips.text: Force short favorable trades before his level 6 spike. Once the realm is online on even terms, his duel math turns against you.
tips.heading: Pre-6 window

tips.text: Build a lead before he goes even or ahead. His matchup eases from parity, so the early kill or plate is what keeps the duel yours.
tips.heading: Lead rule

keyTips.text: Contest level 1. Walk up with E to block her empowered auto, or open Q-start for the early Grasp chunk; never concede the wave for free.

keyTips.text: Sidestep her E and disengage at shroud. Her dash commits her to a line you can leave, and the shroud hides nothing worth chasing into.
keyTips.heading: E discipline

keyTips.text: Force her E before committing the stun. She saves it to answer Counter Strike, so threaten first and stun once the escape is gone.
keyTips.heading: Stun setup

tips.text: Match her farm against your E start. She takes Q to poke when you open E, so hold position and refuse the chase her poke invites.
tips.heading: E-start answer

tips.text: Hold Q when she opens Q-start. She takes E to escape your engage, so threaten the leap without spending it until her exit is gone.
tips.heading: Q-start answer

tips.text: Hold the stun through all three level-6 dashes. She chains dashes to dodge Counter Strike, so wait for the last one before firing.
tips.heading: Post-6 patience

tips.text: Use the early ultimate to zone, not to chase. She backs off when you commit R early, so take the territory instead of diving after her.
tips.heading: Ult zoning

tips.text: Win Grasp short-trade attrition. Repeated blocked-auto exchanges favor you, so stack small wins instead of forcing one big fight.
tips.heading: Attrition plan

tips.text: Finish when her E and shroud are down. Without the escape and the cover, her commit has no exit and your stun decides the duel.

keyTips.text: Block his Q and never sit inside his spin. The silence starts his combo and the spin out-damages your autos, so answer the Q and exit the E.
keyTips.heading: Combo defense

keyTips.text: Respect the level 6 execute in every low-health trade. His ult range bends the whole exchange, so leave before you enter the health where it finishes you.
keyTips.heading: Execute respect

keyTips.text: Re-trade to keep his passive down. His recovery needs quiet time, so short returns stop him healing back between your engages.
keyTips.heading: Regen denial

tips.text: Never leap bare into his spin start. He opens E and shields the jump, so activate Counter Strike before leaping or hold the jump entirely.
tips.heading: Leap setup

tips.text: Vary the stun so his Q-as-stun-ends timing fails. He lands Q right after a predictable E, and an unreadable stun wastes his whole punish.
tips.heading: Stun variation

tips.text: Save your ultimate for the committed all-in, not the short trades. He chips before engaging so your R has less to decide, so hold it for his real commit.
tips.heading: Ult patience

tips.text: Follow his spin with your own engage instead of letting him disengage free. His pattern is E then out, so stick with the leap once his spin ends.
tips.heading: Chasing E

tips.text: Survive the level 6 through mid-game window and scale past him. His advantage lives in that stretch, while your late dueling matches and beats his.
tips.heading: Outscale plan

tips.text: Hold Counter Strike for his Q silence into ult at low health. When he Qs toward you in kill range, the stun on the silence window breaks his execute setup.
tips.heading: Execute answer

keyTips.text: Meet his engages with Counter Strike. E blocks both Q and W, so answer the dash with the shield instead of trading through the stun.

keyTips.text: Stay out of his E circle. The marked zone is the whole engage, so leave it on sight and re-enter only after it fades.
keyTips.heading: E escape

keyTips.text: Let his W mark expire before re-engaging. Unless the kill is certain, break contact at the mark and deny the second-hit heal.
keyTips.heading: Mark discipline

tips.text: Take short trades into his resistances. His bulk wins long exchanges, so hit inside E and step out before the return damage lands.
tips.heading: Short trades

tips.text: Threaten with a held E to zone him. He avoids committing into the shield, so the unspent Counter Strike holds him off the wave.
tips.heading: Shield threat

tips.text: Stop relying on the tower after level 6. His ultimate dive disables it, so keep the lane in open ground instead of turtling low.
tips.heading: Dive respect

tips.text: Re-engage as the mark expires. The expiry is your window back in, since his combo loses the heal threat without it.
tips.heading: Re-entry timing

tips.text: Win the extended duel after mark expiry. Without the second-hit threat, your sustained damage outlasts his combo pattern.
tips.heading: Duel plan

tips.text: Hold E for his committed all-in. The shield that answers the full Q-plus-W decides the late duel, so never spend it on poke.
tips.heading: E discipline

guides.favoredWhen: Jax wins by varying Counter Strike timing to beat Riposte and fighting on good vitals; Fiora wins any extended trade where she stuns him first.

keyTips.text: Vary Counter Strike timing every trade so Riposte cannot predict it. A telegraphed stun gets parried and stunned back, which loses the fight on the spot.
keyTips.heading: Stun timing

keyTips.text: Reset unfavorable vitals through vision before fighting. Give up bad positions and re-engage on a vital you can defend rather than dueling into her best angle.
keyTips.heading: Vital control

keyTips.text: Never open a full fight first when her Riposte is up. The first engager usually loses, so show pressure and force her parry before committing your leap and stun.
keyTips.heading: Engagement rule

tips.text: Leap in behind an active Counter Strike rather than jumping bare. She parries predictable leaps mid-animation, so the stun must already be running when you land on her.
tips.heading: Leap setup

tips.text: Trade short Q auto combos and back off before she extends. Her extended trades beat yours, so chip and leave instead of standing in her vital line.
tips.heading: Short trades

tips.text: Fight after her Riposte is spent, not into it. When she uses W on the wave or a gank, that missing parry is your commit window for the full combo.
tips.heading: Parry downtime

tips.text: Take Ignite if she matches nothing, since the matchup swings hard on summoners. Without her Ignite to answer yours, your committed all-ins stick at low health.
tips.heading: Summoner edge

tips.text: Position near a wall when she commits her ult. The terrain cuts off her vital angles and limits the full-proc healing she needs to win the duel.
tips.heading: Ult answer

tips.text: Peel her off your backline rather than dueling her head-on late. If she saves Riposte for your stun, your team gets more from your counter-engage than from a solo all-in you lose.
tips.heading: Teamfight role

guides.favoredWhen: Jax wins by blocking Crippling Strike, managing the Decimate ring, and all-inning after a missed Apprehend; Darius wins if he stacks Hemorrhage freely and runs Jax down with Ghost after Counter Strike ends.

keyTips.text: Block Crippling Strike with Counter Strike and never let five stacks build. Answer his W with E, then leave before the passive maxes instead of extending into full stacks.
keyTips.heading: Stack denial

keyTips.text: Manage the Decimate ring. Hold outside its outer edge by default; if you cannot leave the edge, leap onto him into the inner ring to deny the heal, the bleed stack, and the bonus damage.
keyTips.heading: Ring control

keyTips.text: All-in after he misses Apprehend, but account for Ghost. A missed E is your window, yet he still runs you down once Counter Strike ends, so commit only when you can finish inside the window.
keyTips.heading: Punish window

tips.text: Trade only with Counter Strike available. His spacing sits at W outer edge beyond your W range, so close with the leap only when E is ready to block the W answer.
tips.heading: Engage rule

tips.text: Refuse his short-trade bait before you have E. He wants W-plus-Q contact without answering your stun, so give ground until E is up rather than conceding free stacks.
tips.heading: Patience

tips.text: Vary the stun because he predicts it. He times his W to land as the dodge ends, so hold Counter Strike longer on some trades and release early on others.
tips.heading: Unreadable E

tips.text: Hold Ignite for his Decimate heal moment. Ignite limits his recovery, so apply it as he commits Q in the all-in rather than spending it on the opening trade.
tips.heading: Ignite timing

tips.text: Disengage when Counter Strike ends if his Ghost is up. He deliberately lets E finish before Ghosting, so step out at E expiry instead of offering the chase.
tips.heading: Respect Ghost

tips.text: End fights before five stacks once Spear of Shojin is done. After that spike he looks for five stacks into the ultimate, so keep trades short and never offer the extended duel.
tips.heading: Post-Shojin rule

itemization.text: Take Flash and Ignite. Ignite answers his Decimate healing in all-ins, and the extra kill pressure fits a lane you are supposed to win.

keyTips.text: At level 1 into melee, walk into their wave, keep swinging, then raise Counter Strike to dodge attacks and boost its return damage.
At level 6, stack two attacks on minions, leap with Q, then auto plus W to stack the third-hit R passive on the reset.
Split to drag enemies off the team, letting allies spend the numbers edge on objectives.

tips.text: Swing at minions before engaging to bank attack-speed passive stacks.
Blunt auto trades with Counter Strike, whose reactivation stuns nearby enemies.
Attack first and press W right after the hit, since Empower resets the basic attack for a fast trade.
Cast W before Q as well so its bonus damage lands with Leap Strike.
Keep a Stealth Ward ready for Q ward-hops into or out of fights.
Default to Grasp for safer lanes, or Lethal Tempo for stat-checks like Darius, Yone, Yasuo, Yorick, or Olaf.
Bait movement before Flash plus Q finishes, since the combo reads predictably.
Rush Trinity Force first for its health, attack speed, Sheen proc, damage, and on-hit movement.
Vision the side lane and watch the minimap, backing off the moment unseen enemies can collapse.
When enemies leave to fight, push hard only while the team disengages safely; otherwise reset and hold objective vision.
Teleport into fights the team can stall until arrival with a surprising flank.
Ward-hop over walls to escape multi-enemy side rotations.
Clear rough lanes with Titanic Hydra waves, accepting it sits outside the standard build.
Convert side pressure into fast towers whenever enemies leave Jax unattended.
Split or join by objective state and whether the team survives a 4v5.
Skip entries with no route to targets into heavy control and disengage.
Hold Q as the ward-hop escape while splitting deep.

itemization.text: Run Grasp with Demolish, Second Wind or Conditioning, and Overgrowth plus Triple Tonic and Jack of All Trades for safe trades and scaling.
Swap Lethal Tempo with Triumph, Legend: Haste, and Last Stand for matchups demanding attack speed in long all-ins.
Start Doran's Shield for safety, with Doran's Bow as the other setup.
Build Trinity Force usual first, or Dusk and Dawn as the Sheen start for AP-bruiser Jax.
Add Spear of Shojin for health, damage, and haste into more frequent ability use.
Rush Blade of the Ruined King into Dr. Mundo builds, accepting weaker early health.

Pick Ionian Boots for cooldowns, Mercury's Treads into heavy control, Plated Steelcaps while far behind into autos, Swiftness Boots into slows, Wit's End for resistance plus tenacity, Randuin's Omen into crit teams, and Zhonya's Hourglass to stall burst for the Counter Strike return.
